name: Broadcom device
note: Broadcom Wi-Fi is frequently proprietary-driver only. Have Ethernet or USB tethering ready.

note: Known flaky; often needs an out-of-tree driver (rtl8821ce) from DKMS.

name: Realtek RTL8852 Wi-Fi

name: Realtek RTL8852BE Wi-Fi
note: Works on kernel 6.2+ (rtw89). Older distros will not see it.

name: Realtek device
note: Ethernet/audio are fine. Wi-Fi varies by model, check the report ID.

name: Intel device
note: Intel has in-kernel drivers for nearly all its chips.

name: MediaTek MT7921 Wi-Fi
note: In-kernel mt7921e driver, works well.

name: MediaTek device
note: Generally in-kernel on recent kernels.

name: Qualcomm Atheros device

name: Qualcomm device
note: In-kernel ath11k/ath12k on recent kernels.

name: AMD GPU/device
note: Open-source amdgpu driver, works out of the box.

name: NVIDIA GPU
note: Works with proprietary driver; install it after setup. Hybrid laptops need PRIME setup.

note: Most Goodix readers have no or partial libfprint support.

name: Synaptics fingerprint reader
note: Some models supported by libfprint, many are not.

name: Elan device
note: Elan touchpads work; Elan fingerprint readers are hit-or-miss.
